    Module

    src/ShiftPlanner.Application/Validation

    Layer application · project ShiftPlanner.Application

    Project navigation: ShiftPlanner.Application

    Overview 🤖

    Contains classes for validating various aspects of shift planning, including absences, breaks, eligibility, and staffing.

    Usage. Used by the API controllers and dashboard to validate shift assignments and schedules before processing.
